name: Heavitree Pleasure Ground Play Area
description: Play area and free paddling pools at Heavitree Pleasure Ground on Whipton Lane, run by Exeter City Council. The play area has a climbing frame and a ride tower suited to toddlers through to young teens. The paddling pools open in summer, 10am to 7pm. The council has consulted on improving the play area and water play, subject to approvals and funding.
